clue.text: Inadequate display after online address is replaced by computer department

indicators.note: one part of the word is swapped out and another put in its place

parts.note: to unfurl a flag or banner is to display it
a URL is a web address
IT, information technology, the office computer department

explanation.surface: A shoddy web display gets handed over to the IT team to fix.
explanation.walkthrough: Take UNFURL, remove URL and put IT in its place to get UNFIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unfit is not good enough for its purpose, a direct synonym of inadequate.

clue.text: Itinerant read 12 in police custody

indicators.note: an itinerant wanders from place to place, so the letters roam into a new order

explanation.surface: A wandering reader of tax forms ends up held by the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone under arrest has been detained by officers and is held in their custody.

clue.text: Able to carry gold and iron — fine

indicators.note: what carries something holds it inside, so the other letters go within

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A strongman fit to carry gold and iron bars sounds fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' looks like an adjective; it is the noun, a penalty. ORFE goes inside FIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A forfeit is a penalty paid for a wrong, just as a fine is a monetary penalty.

clue.text: See 22
Strong wine keeping group of women permanently connected

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: hard as in strong or tough
the Women's Institute, a British community organisation for women

explanation.surface: A potent wine keeps a women's club bound together for good.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardwired circuits are fixed by physical wiring rather than plugged in, so they stay permanently linked.

clue.text: Husband requiring a little practice

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband needs only a little practice at something.
explanation.definitionFit: A habit is a settled practice or routine one regularly follows.

clue.text: Whistle-blower inconclusive on promise not to reveal votes

indicators.note: without a conclusion means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a referee blows the whistle in a match

explanation.surface: A corporate whistle-blower, bound by a gagging promise, stays vague about the votes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistle-blower' suggests an informant, but it is a match official.
explanation.definitionFit: Referenda are popular votes on a single question put directly to the electorate.

clue.text: Turn screw restricting space, with one for every part of car

indicators.note: restricting something hems it in, so a piece is held inside another

parts.note: an en is a printer's space

explanation.surface: Instructions for tightening a screw in a tight space, one for every car part.
explanation.walkthrough: An en is a printer's measure of space, half an em; that crossword convention is the step most solvers miss.
explanation.definitionFit: The windscreen wiper is the blade that sweeps rain from the front glass of a vehicle.

clue.text: One takes stock as trains to station occasionally cancelled

indicators.note: some letters are dropped at intervals, leaving every other one

parts.note: the even letters of these words

explanation.surface: Rail services to the station are now and then called off, leaving someone stocktaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Takes stock' sounds like checking inventory; a risotto literally absorbs stock as it cooks.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked by gradually soaking up hot broth.

clue.text: Perhaps a mate for Bambi or Thumper?

definitions.text: Perhaps a mate for Bambi or Thumper?

parts.words: Perhaps a mate for Bambi or Thumper?
parts.note: surface reading: a girlfriend for one of the Disney cartoon friends
setter's reading: Bambi is a deer and Thumper a rabbit, and one word names the female of both animals

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the female word must fit both a deer and a rabbit.
explanation.definitionFit: A doe is the female of deer and of rabbits, so either character's partner could be one.

clue.text: Wakeboard shattered but not on account of dangerous surfing location?

indicators.note: something shattered is broken into pieces that can be put back in any order
not tells us to leave those letters out of the word

parts.note: o/a is the abbreviation for on account

explanation.surface: A broken wakeboard is blamed on a perilous surf spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Surfing' suggests waves; it is web surfing. Remove O and A from WAKEBOARD before rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: The dark web is a hidden part of the internet reached by special browsers, notorious for illicit trade.

clue.text: Delicacy from chef in Essex

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across these three words

explanation.surface: A tasty treat cooked by a chef working in Essex, an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delicacy' suggests food, but it is the sense of tact or subtlety.
explanation.definitionFit: Finesse is refinement and subtle skill, matching the sense of delicacy as deftness.

clue.text: New Year without a whiskey

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh version, so the letters are rearranged
without means lacking, so a letter is taken out

explanation.surface: Seeing in New Year without a single whiskey.
explanation.definitionFit: Rye is a whiskey distilled mainly from rye grain, common in North America.

clue.text: According to terms of your mortgage agreement you factor in small profits

indicators.note: a term is an end point, so the final letters of each word are taken

parts.words: your mortgage agreement you factor in
parts.note: the last letter of each of these six words
S is the abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Mortgage terms say you must allow for meagre gains.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'small profits' reads as one item, but 'small' gives S and 'profits' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Returns are the gains yielded by an investment, so profits is a straight synonym.

clue.text: Maybe leaves side a little short?

indicators.note: falling a little short means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: Perhaps a team walks off because it is a player down?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb, as in departs; it is the noun, the dried leaves you brew.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is commonly sold and brewed as dried leaves, so leaves are one example of it.

clue.text: Rock Me Amadeus regularly sung as Falco, for instance

indicators.note: to rock is to shake about, so the letters are jumbled
at regular intervals, so every other letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: The 1980s hit Rock Me Amadeus was sung by the Austrian pop star Falco.
explanation.walkthrough: The song title is real, which makes 'Rock' hard to see as an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Falco was the stage pseudonym of Johann Hölzel, so his performing name is an example of an alias.

clue.text: Surprisingly enter into custody

indicators.note: a surprising outcome is an unexpected arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Unexpectedly entering police custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Retention is the act of keeping or holding something, the keeping sense of custody.

clue.text: Rebel is holding note demanding immediate attention

indicators.note: holding means having something inside, so a letter goes within

explanation.surface: A rebel leader holds a note that needs dealing with at once.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is someone who rises in armed revolt against authority.

clue.text: Jumper fits — take it and tops

indicators.note: take away the two letters spelled by the word it

parts.note: a kangaroo, shortened to roo, is a jumper

explanation.surface: The sweater fits, so buy it along with some tops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumper' is British for a sweater, and 'tops' sounds like clothing too; here jumper is a kangaroo and tops are roofs.
explanation.definitionFit: Roofs are the coverings on the upper side of buildings, their tops.

clue.text: Weariness in last bit of The News Quiz essentially

indicators.note: only the final letter of the next word is wanted

parts.note: N is the abbreviation for new, and news is read as more than one N

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its core, so its middle letters are taken

explanation.surface: Boredom setting in by the end of the long-running radio panel show The News Quiz.
explanation.walkthrough: The News Quiz is a BBC Radio 4 satirical comedy show. The Ns are the least certain step of this parse.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is listless boredom and dissatisfaction, a kind of weariness of spirit.

clue.text: Require light like a Christmas tree?

parts.note: an LED is a small electric light

explanation.surface: Fairy lights are needed to dress the Christmas tree.
explanation.walkthrough: Needled is usually 'irritated'; the question mark signals the literal sense of having needles.
explanation.definitionFit: A fir tree bears needles, so a Christmas tree is quite literally covered in them.

clue.text: Caught odd instrument

parts.note: snared means caught in a trap
rum is British slang for odd or strange

explanation.surface: Found in possession of a peculiar musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A snare drum is a percussion instrument with wires stretched across its lower skin.

clue.text: Existence in the outskirts of Rome, Italy, with gangster moving north

indicators.note: the outskirts of a place are its edges, so the outer letters are kept
in a down answer north is upward, so letters shift to an earlier spot

parts.note: Al, as in Al Capone, the letters already in the country's name that move

explanation.surface: Life on the fringes of Rome, with a mobster heading north up Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: The gangster is Al Capone, and he is already in the country's name; in a down clue north means upward, so he moves toward the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, so it is a synonym of existence.

clue.text: Doctor Who not interfering with English film

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are altered

explanation.surface: Doctor Who, the time traveller, refusing to meddle in an English film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor Who' reads as the TV series; 'Doctor' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Towering Inferno is a 1974 disaster movie about a skyscraper blaze.

clue.text: To attract attention make detailed trail less commercial

indicators.note: de-tailed means having its tail removed, losing the final letter
less means minus, so the following letters come out

parts.note: to shadow someone is to trail them

explanation.surface: Producing a detailed trailer without advertising, just to get noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' reads as 'thorough'; split it as de-tailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Done for show means done for appearance's sake, to impress or be noticed.

clue.text: Returning in encore, Rihanna's an engaging sort

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the words that follow
returning means going back, so the letters read right to left

explanation.surface: Rihanna comes back for an encore and charms the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engaging' suggests charming; here it means taking on, as in engaging staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A hirer is one who hires or engages people or goods, so an engaging sort in the employing sense.

clue.text: Help dry right out

indicators.note: out means removed, so that letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Assistance to dry things out properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid is assistance or support given to someone, a plain synonym for help.

clue.text: Ultimately the morning after, a group of tennis players must go back on the run

indicators.note: going back means the whole string is read in the opposite direction
ultimately means at the end, so the last letter of each word is taken

parts.note: the final letter of each of the three words
the Lawn Tennis Association, British tennis's governing body

explanation.surface: After a night out, a group of tennis players must head back while still on the run.
explanation.definitionFit: A criminal at large is still free and uncaught, the same as being on the run.

clue.text: Sky broadcast

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to put out on radio or television

explanation.walkthrough: Sky is also a British TV broadcaster, which welds the two words into one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Air is the atmosphere above us, and to air a programme is to transmit it.

clue.text: Copy theatre and student arts venue

parts.note: a rep is a repertory theatre
L for learner, as on a British learner driver's L-plate
the Institute of Contemporary Arts in London

explanation.surface: A cheap copy of a theatre and student arts centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A replica is an exact reproduction of an original, i.e. a copy.

clue.text: For one famous DJ retirement's beginning in Spain — goodbye Jack

definitions.note: the answer is the category; the definition gives an example of it

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter only

parts.note: jack and tar are both old words for a sailor

explanation.surface: A well-known DJ is retiring to Spain and says farewell to someone called Jack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For one' marks the famous DJ as an example of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrated disc jockey is a radio star, a famous broadcaster on the airwaves.

clue.text: Focus of recording before Herb Alpert finally cut verse

indicators.note: the focus is the centre, so the middle letter is chosen
cut means removed, so that letter is taken away
finally points at the last letter of the name

explanation.surface: Trumpeter Herb Alpert finally edits a verse out of a recording.
explanation.walkthrough: Herb Alpert is an American trumpeter and bandleader; his first name is the herb.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyme is poetry or verse, especially lines with matching end sounds.
